decisions.reason: This low-pile decorative carpet sits close to the core offer and costs little to keep in a broad collection, and two years on the market still do not fully resolve its value, so the option stays open.
It overlaps with other rug designs, which raises the chance of pruning, but its holding cost is low and no negative signal has emerged, so it is kept for now.
The corner bench extends the upholstery and dining offer for residential and hospitality projects, where project cycles are long, so its option value justifies more time on the market.
Keeping this low-pile carpet costs little within a broad portfolio, and the evidence so far does not show that its value will fail to materialize.
A multi-model swivel shell chair line serving both contract and residential markets is a larger commitment with growth potential, worth holding while demand develops.
